description: Grounded no-wing veiled desert wanderer: approved base clothing/silhouette, unqualified directional masters and unframed dialogue head. This is a planning manifest, NOT renderable animation artwork.
subject: Sky Blue Eyes — The Veiled Wanderer (wingless, three feathered tails), monk with independently animated dormant Shattered Sunblade

health_variants.note: Two presentation tiers only; no fatigued/mid-health animation tier. Death remains a separate state.

directions.note: Reference degrees are character orientation labels, not camera orbit or 3D rig. Gameplay side-scroller initially qualifies right/left; eight views are reference coverage, not eight full action animation sets.

target.face_reveal_policy: hide muzzle and mouth in normal gameplay and dialogue; visible eyes only; any identity reveal requires separate narrative approval

eye_design.distant: apparent softly luminous sapphire/teal eyes; keep readability and modest glow
eye_design.closeup: deep cosmic iris, centered black-hole-like pupil with blue/teal accretion rings, dust and minute stars
eye_design.trails: subtle short light traces on gaze movement, not permanently exaggerated particle bursts
eye_design.visibility: at least one eye clear through hood shadow in all relevant facings; back-facing may show neither

weapon.appearance: cloth-wrapped broken relic, low energy, tied phoenix feathers; no baked fire/frost/wind/light effects
weapon.note: One blade motion family, optional aspect effect overlays; effects and puzzle logic are separate host responsibilities.

reference_slots.notes: Spotted tall feline anatomy, broad flame feather wings, bifurcated tail, bright blue eyes; scenic lighting not a clean sprite source.
Cream/saffron/gold combat wraps and red cloth; other figures in the crop are not separate approved character views.
Six illustrated Shattered Sunblade concepts. Baseline selection and physical sword silhouette still need a canonical lock.
Bright orange solar streak with blue traces. Concept only; not a frame-accurate transparent animation.

Creator approved hood, mouth-covering ocher scarf, layered cream/saffron/red tattered robes, ornate gold solar brooch and accents, exposed spotted feline hands and feet, feather accents, and mysterious silhouette. Original image is three-quarter side character illustration with one inset framed head study, NOT an 8-way production turnaround.

visual_invariants: no wings in V1, no wing anchor or flying/glide animation
hood conceals upper face; wrapped veil conceals mouth and muzzle silhouette
galactic irises with black-hole-like pupils, teal/blue accretion stars, subtle light trails, readable blue at gameplay scale
three separate feathered phoenix tails, consistent number and roots in all applicable angles, orange-red feathers with restrained blue accents
cream and saffron layered wraps, tattered red mantle, gold solar brooch and hood emblem match approved wardrobe reference
feline muzzle/ears and spotted warm-brown forearms/hands/feet remain anatomically consistent, no exposed mouth during dialogue
dormant broken cloth-wrapped sword remains visually distinct, separately rendered, tied feathers, no permanent element glow
pending_decisions: clean isolated full-resolution views with consistent garment seams and left/right asymmetry
tail-root occlusion and three discrete tails visible from back, appropriate partial occlusion in true side view
native scale silhouette and crop/pivot validation
default dormant Sunblade exact silhouette and proportion
unframed head dialogue poses matching same cloak/veil and galaxy eyes
original reference image handoff to durable source repository and rights documentation
confirmed_design_decisions: approved original reference image source hash
cosmic blue/teal iris with dark pupil
two health art tiers split at 36%

transition_checks.policy: normal when health_percent > 36; low when <= 36; no extra middle tier

qa_gates.evidence: signed model sheet / native-scale silhouette / anchors / palette / licensing
first-last seam and adjacent-frame contact review at native scale
run-to-stop-to-idle rooted foot positions and frame-by-frame inspection
sword orbit follows root without world-space teleport during body movement
All three tail roots remain attached and cloth occlusion is correct through every authored idle/run frame
exact final ZIP reimported, source and preview pixels compared
Only normal (health>36) and low (health<=36) art tiers; exact boundary and 0-health death action are tested; no invented middle state
host 60Hz jump accepted immediately, art follows physical phase
one semantic strike cue despite hitstop/replay and a legal cancel window
Unframed head sprites: hood/veil/eye identity consistent across front, side, three-quarter; masked talk and blink cues remain expressive

milestones.name: Canonical reference lock and production plan
Right-facing idle + run-stop + sword orbit qualification
Two-tier low-health idle, rare idle, jump/land transitions
Combat, parry, sword cast/recall and timed cues
Secondary motion, effects and portrait presentation
Expansion via reusable animation family inventory

provenance.failed_generation_notes: Initial wide infographic turnarounds generated after the cloak approval were not qualified: small inconsistent figures and head portraits in frames instead of isolated frame sources.
